name: fluxie-brain
description: Shared graph memory for AI agents that gets smarter with use.

scripts.check:fast: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && gitleaks git --pre-commit --redact --no-banner && node scripts/floor-guard.mjs
scripts.check:task: pnpm check:fast && pnpm check:arch && pnpm test:coverage && node scripts/changed-coverage.ts
scripts.check:sast: docker run --rm -v .:/src -w /src semgrep/semgrep:1.186.0 semgrep scan --config p/default --config p/owasp-top-ten --severity ERROR --error --metrics=off --quiet src scripts docker
scripts.check:full: pnpm check:task && pnpm check:secrets && pnpm check:deps && pnpm check:sast
